outcome: Give Banking teams a working Intelligent Onboarding & KYC Automation capability on their own data — it slashes onboarding abandonment and cost-per-acquisition.
overview: Every applicant who abandons a digital account opening takes the acquisition spend with them, and in Gulf retail banking the speed of KYC is now a competitive position rather than a back-office detail. Intelligent Onboarding & KYC Automation extracts and validates identity documents, runs the liveness check, screens against sanctions and PEP lists, assigns a risk tier and syncs the result to CRM — turning a day-plus wait into minutes and leaving an audit-ready KYC record behind. High-risk cases and records that fail validation still route to a human reviewer. The four-to-five week MVP runs on the bank's own document flow so drop-off and activation time can be measured, not assumed.
